versions.short: The bill would designate the Finger Lakes National Heritage Area in New York, covering Cayuga, Chemung, Cortland, Livingston, Monroe, Onondaga, Ontario, Schuyler, Seneca, Steuben, Tioga, Tompkins, Wayne, and Yates Counties, and add it to the national heritage area system. It would name the Finger Lakes Tourism Alliance as the local group responsible for coordinating the area. The bill would require that group to submit a proposed management plan for the area to the Secretary of the Interior for approval within 3 years of enactment. It would also end the Secretary's authority to provide assistance for the area 15 years after enactment.
